def quiet(self, scope: str, endpoint: dict, *, browser: bool = False) -> bool:
        self.guest(scope, endpoint, "identity")
        state = self.guest(scope, endpoint, "state")
        # Explicit presence/type is required; omitted fields never mean quiet.
        return (state.get("status") == "ok" and state.get("processes") == []
                and state.get("tmux") == [] and type(state.get("runs")) is int
                and state["runs"] == 0 and isinstance(state.get("browser"), dict)
                and type(state["browser"].get("pending_actions")) is int
                and state["browser"]["pending_actions"] == 0
                and (not browser or state["browser"].get("running") is False))

name: successful-create receipt restarts stopped partial disk
old:
if [ "$state" = stopped ] && [ -f "$intent" ]; then
        owned_boot=$(cat "$intent")
        # A private successful-create receipt is the pre-publication ownership
        # authority. Restart its retained disk, then publish the observed boot.
        if [[ "$owned_boot" != "$box "* ]] || [ -z "${owned_boot#"$box "}" ]; then
            log "conflicting partial scope ownership"; exit 4
        fi
        scope_egress "$box" || exit 4
        sbx start "$box" </dev/null || exit 6
        live_boot=$(sbx exec -u root "$box" cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id </dev/null) || exit 5
        [ -n "$live_boot" ] || exit 5
        printf '%s %s\n' "$box" "$live_boot" > "$intent" || exit 5
        state=$(scope_state "$scope")
    fi
